thread:
Maya: Alert from budget-sentinel for Acero Health (acct: ACERO-22). Embedding route blew past daily threshold overnight. Need a QBR-ready summary and mitigation plan by tomorrow. :warning:
Diego: saw it. Dashboard snapshot: https://console.redwood/clients/acero/spend — daily tokens ~2.2M, projected monthly ~66M. Likely because they bulk-ingested records without dedupe.
Priya: they used the default import pipeline. I'll schedule a 20m enablement to walk them through chunking + dedupe + Optimize presets. Can do tomorrow 11am PT.
Tom: quick triage checklist to reduce burn immediately:
```
- enable embedding batching (batch_size=128)
- enable pre-ingest dedupe (hash) on imports
- enable prefix caching for repeated metadata
- temporarily throttle ingestion > 1M/day
```
OpsBot: [budget-alert] ACERO-22 threshold breached: today_tokens=2,232,101 (projected_month=66,960,000). Trigger: embed-ingest-bulk. Actions: notify-cs, suggest-temp-throttle, escalate-to-finops.
Maya: For QBR we need 3 scenarios (tokens + $):
1) Conservative: throttle + batching + dedupe
2) Moderate: batching + quantization on non-prod models
3) Baseline: no changes
Diego: I'll produce a slide with token projections and a sensitivity table (adoption 25/50/100%). SQL I use to split routes:
```
SELECT route, sum(tokens) as tokens, sum(cost_usd) as cost
FROM token_events
WHERE account_id='ACERO-22' AND ts >= '2026-03-01'
GROUP BY route
ORDER BY tokens DESC;
```
Priya: I'll capture any doc gaps during the session and collect acceptance of the temporary throttle. Draft customer note I'll send after the call:
"Hi Acero team — we observed a high-volume embedding import driving elevated token usage. We recommend a short session to enable batching, dedupe, and Optimize presets. We can also enable a temporary throttle until changes are live. Reply to accept the throttle."
Tom: Ops — can you create a budget rule we can flip on for immediate relief? Something like pause ingestion when daily tokens > 2,500,000 and fallback to 50% throttle.
OpsBot: [action_created] budget_rule/acero-temp-throttle-189999 by Diego. Rule: pause ingestion when daily_tokens > 2,500,000; fallback_throttle=50%; notify=@customer-success.
Maya: Great. Diego can you add the three projection slides to the QBR deck and include the one-liner: "Bulk onboarding ingestion spiked embeddings; mitigations project 30-65% monthly token reduction depending on adoption."
Diego: on it. Priya will you compile customer feedback snippets for the QBR renewal slide? Note whether they accept throttle and adopt Optimize presets within 7 days (colors: green/amber/red).
Priya: yes, will collect and add to the QBR notes.
Maya: thanks team. Keep thread updated after the enablement and paste any customer quotes. I'll stitch the final QBR slide before EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
